text: dsh-reasoning-adapter 是一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的模型路由插件。它监听自定义模型路由配置，按模型标识、显示名称和接口地址识别厂商，并补充对应推理档位及兼容字段。插件还可将匹配结果写回 profile 配置，并在模型设置页提供状态和重新匹配操作。适合通过中转、自建网关或算力平台接入模型、希望在 DSH 中选择合适推理等级的用户。默认不需额外密钥；写回功能会在本机 profile 配置中保存档位和匹配记录。

dsh-reasoning-adapter adds vendor-aware reasoning levels to custom DSH model routes. It detects vendors and supplies matching choices and compatibility fields. A Models panel shows status and supports rematching. It suits relay or self-hosted API users. No extra key is set.
想让自定义模型路由也显示厂商支持的推理等级。
中转接入的模型推理档位不对，能按厂商自动适配吗？
Show the correct reasoning effort choices for models on my custom API routes.
dsh-reasoning-adapter 的功能「自定义路由推理档位」：配置模型时按模型和路由信息识别厂商，补上匹配的推理等级及兼容字段，让 DSH 可用对应选项。
dsh-reasoning-adapter 的功能「模型状态与重新匹配」：模型设置页显示各模型的匹配状态，并允许用户通过按钮将单个模型或一条路由的模型重新交给插件匹配。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · dsh-reasoning-adapter：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-reasoning-adapter)
[](https://github.com/Hatiaa/dsh-reasoning-adapter/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 插件：让**中转站 / 自建网关 / 算力平台**上的模型，也能在对话框里选推理等级。

官方路由的模型自带推理元数据，选择器里有档位行。自己添加的路由只有 `api`、`baseURL` 和一串模型 id，
DSH 不知道这些模型支持哪些档位、该发什么字段，于是档位行不显示；手动打开「模型设置」里的推理开关，
得到的是通用的 `off / low / medium / high`，换成 GLM、Kimi、Claude 这类模型，要么缺档位，要么请求被服务端拒绝。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · dsh-reasoning-adapter：这个插件根据模型名认出厂商，填入**这家模型真正接受的档位**和**对应的请求字段**，
并把结果写进你的配置，「模型设置」页的推理开关会自动打开。装上即生效，不需要配置。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 效果：| 模型 id | 路由协议（`api`） | 选择器档位 | 请求里发送 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-opus-5.5`、`cl-op-5.5` | `anthropic-messages` | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `thinking: {type: adaptive}` + `output_config.effort` |
| `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` | `openai-completions` | off / low / high / max | `thinking` + `reasoning_effort`，工具循环回放 `reasoning_content` |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `anthropic-messages` | off / high | `thinking: {type: enabled, budget_tokens}` |
| `GLM-5.3` | `openai-completions` | low / high / max | `thinking`（Z.ai 格式）+ `reasoning_effort` |
| `Kimi-K3.1-Pro-HighSpeed` | `openai-completions` | low / high / max | `reasoning_effort`，工具循环回放 `reasoning_content` |
| `qwen3.8-max` | `openai-completions` | low / medium / xhigh | `enable_thinking` + `reasoning_effort` |
| `gpt-6.1-sol` | `openai-completions` | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `reasoning_effort` |
| `gemini-3.5-flash` | `openai-completions` | minimal / low / medium / high | `reasoning_effort` |
| `my-private-model` | 任意 | 不改动 | — |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 效果：同一个模型走不同协议，档位可能不同，以上只是举例。全部 28 种组合（含线上值和 compat 字段）
见 [docs/levels.md](docs/levels.md)，该表由代码生成，CI 校验它与代码一致。

覆盖的厂商：Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包、MiMo。
厂商识别依次看模型 id、显示名、关键词模糊匹配（容忍 `claud`、`deepsek` 这类拼写），最后看接口域名；
`deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro` 这种带前缀的 id 和 `cl-op-5.5` 这种中转站缩写也能认。
**认不出的模型不会被改动**：猜错档位会让请求直接失败，不如保持原样。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x**（`dsh --version` 查看）。插件声明了 `engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-0`，
版本不符时 DSH 会拒绝安装。

```sh
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 桌面版：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reasoning-adapter

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Web 版：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reasoning-adapter
```

装好后重启 DSH。

**确认是否生效**：打开对话框的模型选择器，切到一个自定义路由的模型，看是否出现推理等级行；
或者打开「设置 → 模型」，这些模型的推理开关应该已经打开，档位与上表一致。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 工作方式：插件分两层工作：

1. **运行时匹配**：DSH 每次加载模型配置时，插件给自定义路由上的模型补上档位和 compat 字段。
   这一层只在内存里生效，不改文件。插件启用后，选择器立刻出现档位。
2. **写回配置**：大约一秒后，插件通过 DSH 自带的配置编辑器（与「模型设置」页保存时走同一个接口：
   加锁、校验、失败回滚）把同样的档位写进 profile 配置。这样「模型设置」页的开关显示为打开，
   即使以后停用或卸载插件，档位也会保留。

只处理同时写了 `api` 和 `baseURL` 的路由，官方目录路由不改。新添加的模型或路由会在保存后自动匹配。
不想让插件写配置文件，把 `writeConfig` 设为 `false`，只保留运行时匹配。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 你的设置优先：插件按模型记录自己写过什么（`<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/auto-match.json`），判断哪些模型由你管理：

| 你做了什么 | 插件的处理 |
|---|---|
| 新加了一个模型 | 识别厂商，写入档位，开关自动打开 |
| 在「模型设置」里打开开关（生成了默认的 off/low/medium/high） | 替换为该厂商的真实档位，之后由插件管理 |
| 手动改过某个模型的档位 | 视为你在管理，不再写入；你的档位原样使用，只补充你没写的 compat 字段 |
| 关掉了某个模型的开关 | 不再打开，选择器里也不显示这个模型的档位 |
| 删除了某个模型 | 清掉对应记录，之后重新添加会当作新模型 |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 交回插件：「用插件档位覆写」：「设置 → 模型」里每个自定义路由的卡片下方有一块「推理等级（dsh-reasoning-adapter）」，
列出这条路由上每个模型的状态（已自动匹配 / 已关闭 / 手动设置 / 未识别厂商……）。

对于已关闭或手动设置过的模型，旁边有 **用插件档位覆写** 按钮：点一下，插件立即把该厂商的档位写进配置，
开关重新打开，此后这个模型重新由插件管理。鼠标悬停在按钮上可以看到将要写入的档位。
一条路由上有多个这样的模型时，还会出现 **全部交回插件**。

识别不出厂商的模型没有这个按钮，因为插件不知道该写什么；请先用 `overrides` 指定厂商。
`writeConfig: false` 时这块只显示状态，不提供按钮。
section: 交回插件：「用插件档位覆写」

text:
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 配置：默认配置适合大多数情况。需要调整时，编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`，
添加一条按 id 覆盖的配置（不要另写一条 `insert`），只写需要改的项：

```yaml
- id: reasoning-adapter
  config:
    writeConfig: false
```

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 配置：| 选项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `writeConfig` | `true` | 是否把匹配结果写进 profile 配置 |
| `replaceSettingsTemplate` | `true` | 是否把「模型设置」开关生成的默认档位替换成厂商真实档位 |
| `fixCompat` | `true` | 是否补充 compat 字段（adaptive thinking、`reasoning_content` 回放、非 OpenAI 厂商用 `system` 而不是 `developer` 角色等） |
| `keepCommonLevels` | `false` | 设为 `true` 后，厂商缺少的 low / medium / high 也会显示，并映射到最接近的真实档位 |
| `defaultEffort` | `high` | 路由默认档位。只有该路由所有模型都支持这一档时才设置，且只在运行时生效，不写进配置 |
| `anthropicAdaptiveVendors` | `[]` | 声明哪些厂商的 Anthropic 兼容接口支持 adaptive thinking（如 `[deepseek, glm]`），这些厂商在该协议下会获得更多档位 |
| `overrides` | `{}` | 针对单个模型的规则，见下文 |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · overrides：键是 glob（`*` 通配，不区分大小写），匹配 `路由/模型id` 或 `模型id`，按顺序取第一条命中的规则：

```yaml
- id: reasoning-adapter
  config:
    overrides:
      # 认不出的模型：指定厂商，档位和字段按该厂商规则生成

`vendor` 可选值：`claude` `openai` `deepseek` `glm` `kimi` `qwen` `gemini` `grok` `doubao` `mimo` `minimax`。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 验证情况：在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5（Windows）上，通过两个中转站对 11 个模型做了实测：每个模型以默认档位完成一次带工具调用的往返，
同时抓取请求体，检查推理字段：

- ✅ `openai-completions`：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3、GLM-5.3-FlashX、Kimi K3.1，推理字段正确，`reasoning_content` 正确回放，system 消息以 `system` 角色发送；
- ✅ `anthropic-messages`：三个 Claude 模型（Opus / Sonnet 5.5、Fable 5.1；adaptive + `output_config.effort`）、DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4.1 Flash（`budget_tokens`）；

Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包、MiMo，以及经 `openai-completions` 访问 GPT/Claude 的规则，依据 DSH 内置模型目录的元数据编写，
**未实测**。如果你实际使用中发现档位不对，欢迎提 issue 或 PR。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 排查：插件把诊断信息写到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/status.json`（每个 profile 单独一份）：

- `reports`：每个模型识别出的厂商、依据（id / 显示名 / 模糊匹配 / 域名）、档位、补充的 compat；
- `models`：DSH 实际提供给选择器的档位和默认档位；
- `match`：写回配置的结果。`wrote: true` 表示这次写入了，`reason: "already matched"` 表示配置已经一致，无需写入；其他 `reason` 是失败原因，此时档位仍由运行时匹配提供。

提 issue 时附上这个文件，能大大加快定位。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-reasoning-adapter
```

已经写进配置的档位会保留，模型继续按这些档位工作。如果不需要，在「设置 → 模型」里关掉对应开关即可。
插件的记录目录 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/` 可以直接删除。

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · 开发：不需要构建，没有运行时依赖。测试使用 Node 内置的测试运行器（Node 20+）：

```sh
npm test         # 单元测试：厂商识别、档位规则、compat 过滤、写回逻辑
npm run check    # 语法检查 + 单元测试
npm run matrix   # 根据 rules.js 重新生成 docs/levels.md
```

在 DSH 里调试本地代码：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/绝对路径/dsh-reasoning-adapter`，
修改后在插件管理里关闭再打开插件即可重新加载。
新增厂商或修正档位的步骤见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

[中文](README.md) | English

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives models served through **relays, self-hosted gateways and compute platforms**
the same reasoning-effort picker that official routes have.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · dsh-reasoning-adapter：Official routes ship reasoning metadata, so the composer shows an effort row. A route you add yourself is only
`api`, `baseURL` and a list of model ids: DSH cannot know which levels those models accept or which request field
carries them, so the row stays hidden. Turning on the reasoning switch on the Models settings page gives you a generic
`off / low / medium / high`, which is missing levels for some vendors and sends values that others reject.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · dsh-reasoning-adapter：This plugin recognises the vendor from the model name, fills in **the levels that vendor actually accepts** and
**the request fields it expects**, and writes the result into your configuration so the Models page switch turns on
by itself. It works out of the box; there is nothing to configure.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · What you get：| Model id | Route protocol (`api`) | Picker levels | Sent on the wire |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-opus-5.5`, `cl-op-5.5` | `anthropic-messages` | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `thinking: {type: adaptive}` + `output_config.effort` |
| `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` | `openai-completions` | off / low / high / max | `thinking` + `reasoning_effort`; `reasoning_content` replayed in tool loops |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `anthropic-messages` | off / high | `thinking: {type: enabled, budget_tokens}` |
| `GLM-5.3` | `openai-completions` | low / high / max | `thinking` (Z.ai format) + `reasoning_effort` |
| `Kimi-K3.1-Pro-HighSpeed` | `openai-completions` | low / high / max | `reasoning_effort`; `reasoning_content` replayed in tool loops |
| `qwen3.8-max` | `openai-completions` | low / medium / xhigh | `enable_thinking` + `reasoning_effort` |
| `gpt-6.1-sol` | `openai-completions` | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `reasoning_effort` |
| `gemini-3.5-flash` | `openai-completions` | minimal / low / medium / high | `reasoning_effort` |
| `my-private-model` | any | left unchanged | — |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · What you get：The same model can get different levels over different protocols; the rows above are examples. All 28 combinations,
with wire values and compat fields, are in [docs/levels.md](docs/levels.md), which is generated from the code and
checked by CI.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · What you get：Vendors: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Doubao, MiMo. Detection looks at the model id, then the
display name, then fuzzy keywords (tolerating typos such as `claud` or `deepsek`), and only then the endpoint host.
Prefixed ids like `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro` and relay abbreviations like `cl-op-5.5` are recognised.
**A model it cannot recognise is left alone**: a wrong guess would make requests fail, which is worse than no picker.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** (check with `dsh --version`). The plugin declares `engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-0`,
so DSH refuses to install it on an incompatible host.

```sh
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Desktop app：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reasoning-adapter

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Web：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reasoning-adapter
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

**Check that it works**: open the composer's model picker on a model from a custom route and look for the effort
row, or open Settings → Models, where those models' reasoning switches should already be on with the levels above.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · How it works：1. **Runtime match.** Whenever DSH loads the model configuration, the plugin adds levels and compat fields to models
   on custom routes. This happens in memory only, and the picker shows levels as soon as the plugin is enabled.
2. **Write-back.** About a second later the plugin writes the same levels into the profile configuration through
   DSH's own config editor, the same path the Models page uses when you save (file lock, validation, rollback on
   failure). The Models page switch then shows as on, and the levels stay even if you later disable or uninstall
   the plugin.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · How it works：Only routes that declare both `api` and `baseURL` are touched; official catalog routes are not. Models or routes you
add later are matched automatically after you save. Set `writeConfig: false` to keep the runtime match and never
write the config file.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Your settings win：The plugin records per model what it wrote (`<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/auto-match.json`) to tell which
models you manage yourself:

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Your settings win：| What you did | What the plugin does |
|---|---|
| Added a new model | Detects the vendor, writes its levels, turns the switch on |
| Turned the switch on in Settings → Models (generic off/low/medium/high) | Replaces it with the vendor's real levels and manages the model from then on |
| Edited a model's levels by hand | Treats the model as yours and stops writing; your levels are used as-is, and only compat fields you did not set are filled in |
| Turned a model's switch off | Never turns it back on, and the picker shows no levels for it |
| Removed a model | Drops its record; adding it again counts as a new model |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Handing a model back: "Overwrite with plugin levels"：In Settings → Models, every custom route's card ends with a **Reasoning levels (dsh-reasoning-adapter)** block listing
each model's state (matched / switched off / set by you / vendor not recognised, ...).
section: Handing a model back: "Overwrite with plugin levels"

text:
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Handing a model back: "Overwrite with plugin levels"：A model you switched off or edited gets an **Overwrite with plugin levels** button. One click writes the vendor's
levels into the configuration right away, turns the switch back on, and the plugin manages the model again from
then on. Hover the button to see the levels it will write. When a route has several such models, a
**Hand all back to the plugin** button appears as well.
section: Handing a model back: "Overwrite with plugin levels"

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Handing a model back: "Overwrite with plugin levels"：A model whose vendor is not recognised has no button, since the plugin would not know what to write; name the vendor
with `overrides` first. With `writeConfig: false` the block shows status only.

text:
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Configuration：The defaults suit most setups. To change them, edit `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` and add an
id-targeted override (not a second `insert`) containing only the keys you change:

```yaml
- id: reasoning-adapter
  config:
    writeConfig: false
```

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `writeConfig` | `true` | Write the matched levels into the profile configuration |
| `replaceSettingsTemplate` | `true` | Replace the generic levels created by the Models page switch with the vendor's real levels |
| `fixCompat` | `true` | Fill in compat fields (adaptive thinking, `reasoning_content` replay, `system` rather than `developer` role for non-OpenAI vendors, ...) |
| `keepCommonLevels` | `false` | When `true`, low / medium / high are always shown, mapped to the nearest level the vendor really has |
| `defaultEffort` | `high` | Route default level. Set only when every model on the route offers it, and only at runtime (not written to the config) |
| `anthropicAdaptiveVendors` | `[]` | Vendors whose Anthropic-compatible endpoint accepts adaptive thinking (e.g. `[deepseek, glm]`); they get more levels on that protocol |
| `overrides` | `{}` | Per-model rules, see below |

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · overrides：Keys are case-insensitive globs (`*` wildcard) matched against `route/modelId` or `modelId`; the first match wins:

```yaml
- id: reasoning-adapter
  config:
    overrides:
      # Unrecognised model: name the vendor and its rules apply

`vendor` accepts `claude` `openai` `deepseek` `glm` `kimi` `qwen` `gemini` `grok` `doubao` `mimo` `minimax`.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Verification：Tested live on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (Windows) against 11 models on two relays: one tool-call round trip per model at the
default level, with the request body captured to check the reasoning fields.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Verification：- ✅ `openai-completions`: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-FlashX, Kimi K3.1. Reasoning fields correct, `reasoning_content` replayed, system message sent with the `system` role.
- ✅ `anthropic-messages`: three Claude models (Opus / Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1; adaptive + `output_config.effort`), DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4.1 Flash (`budget_tokens`).
- ❌ Two GPT models on one relay: the relay causes the failure and the plugin cannot fix it; see Known limitations.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Verification：The rules for Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Doubao and MiMo, and for GPT/Claude over `openai-completions`, follow DSH's built-in
model catalog metadata and are **not tested live**. If you find a wrong level, please open an issue or a PR.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Known limitations：- **Relays that rewrite requests.** Some relays turn Anthropic-format requests into OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions`, and
  the upstream then rejects reasoning parameters when tools are present, with errors like
  `Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported for gpt-6-astra in /v1/chat/completions`. It still fails
  with every reasoning field removed, so the relay is the cause and `skip` does not help. Only the relay can fix it,
  by switching to `/v1/responses`.
- **Old sessions may name a removed level.** The plugin drops levels a vendor does not accept (GLM-5.3 has no
  `medium`, for example). Returning to a session that saved such a level shows an "unsupported" error; pick a level
  again.
- **Vendor rules age.** The tables reflect vendor documentation at the time of writing. When a vendor ships a new
  model or changes its levels, use `overrides` in the meantime and tell us so the rules can be updated.
- **Picker not refreshed.** The plugin asks the client to reload the model list; if the effort row still has not
  updated, reload the page.
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Troubleshooting：The plugin writes diagnostics to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/status.json`, one file per profile:
dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Troubleshooting：Attaching this file to an issue makes it much faster to diagnose.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-reasoning-adapter
```

Levels already written into the configuration stay, and those models keep working with them. Turn the switches off
in Settings → Models if you no longer want them. The plugin's record directory
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.dsh-reasoning-adapter/` can simply be deleted.

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Development：No build step and no runtime dependencies. Tests use Node's built-in test runner (Node 20+):

```sh
npm test         # unit tests: vendor detection, level rules, compat filtering, write-back logic
npm run check    # syntax check + unit tests
npm run matrix   # regenerate docs/levels.md from rules.js
```

dsh-reasoning-adapter README · Development：To run a local checkout inside DSH: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-reasoning-adapter`,
then turn the plugin off and on again in the plugin manager to reload your changes.
